description: This file defines an Android Fragment class named LogFragment, which provides a UI component for displaying log messages using a LogView inside a ScrollView. It manages the creation, layout, and behavior of the log display, including text change handling to scroll to the bottom when new log entries are added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a LogView inside a ScrollView, used for displaying logs with automatic scrolling to the latest entries.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and sets up the ScrollView and LogView, including layout parameters and styling, then returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method to create and initialize the fragment's view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom when log text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used by the fragment.
